text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from Period 1 to Period 10, but the recent decline shows that gains can reverse; I should expect volatility rather than extrapolate recent performance.","I made no trades, so these results reflect holding through both gains and losses; I should continue to avoid impulsive reactions while checking that my holdings still fit my goals and risk tolerance.","A short record across ten months cannot establish whether my approach is successful; I should assess it over a longer horizon and make changes only for clear, considered reasons."]}
